root_cause.text: In isotp_release(), the wait_event_interruptible() loop can exit early due to a signal, leading to immediate kfree(so->tx.buf) while isotp_sendmsg() may still be accessing so->tx.buf for the final CAN frame, causing a use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states: "If a signal interrupts the wait_event_interruptible() inside close() while tx.state is ISOTP_SENDING, the loop exits early and release proceeds to force ISOTP_SHUTDOWN and continues to kfree(so->tx.buf) while sendmsg may still be reading so->tx.buf." The patch moves the kfree() of potentially extended buffers from isotp_release() to isotp_sock_destruct(), ensuring the buffers are freed only after all socket references are gone.
